Call for Abstracts Now Open | 4th CARCIL National Conference on Securities Laws

In response to the numerous requests received from participants across the country, the Centre for Advanced Research on Corporate and Insolvency Laws (CARCIL), Chanakya National Law University, Patna, is pleased to announce that the Call for Abstracts for the 4th CARCIL National Conference on Securities Laws is now open.

Important Dates
• Abstract Submission Deadline: 6 August 2026
• Rolling Intimation to the Top 32 Selected Abstracts: Till 10 August 2026 (on a first-come, first-served basis)
• Full Paper Submission Deadline: 28 August 2026
• Conference & Paper Presentation:3 September 2026(On Campus at CNLU, Patna)

The Top 32 selected abstracts will be published in the Conference Abstract Book, and their authors will be invited to present their papers on campus.

Fee Structure
• Abstract Submission Fee: ₹500
• Conference Registration Fee (upon selection):
– ₹2,000 (Single Author)
– ₹3,500 (Author with One Co-author)

The conference registration fee includes the Conference Kit, Abstract Book, Lunch, and Dinner. Due to limited availability, preference for on-campus accommodation will be given to female participants (First Come First Serve Basis).

Authors may either submit an Abstract or directly submit their Full Paper.

Abstract Submission Link: https://lnkd.in/dgtDdkmB
Link for Full Paper Submission: https://lnkd.in/dQ2YeB2N

We look forward to receiving your submissions and welcoming you to CNLU, Patna.
